declarations.name: Dialog.Content
declarations.description:
Portal, backdrop and the popup. Focus moves inside on open and returns to the trigger on close. A dialog opened
from inside another has its own backdrop too, over the first dialog.
Menus, selects and tooltips opened from inside render above it (`--proto-z-dropdown` > `--proto-z-dialog`).

In the default `dialog` variant the children render inside `div.c-proto-dialog__scroll`, the popup's only child, and that
is what scrolls (with the × in it, so the × scrolls away with the title as before): its scrollbar sits centred in
the popup's side padding instead of against the popup's edge (dialog.css). A `sheet` and a `fullscreen` dialog have
no wrapper; their `Dialog.Body` scrolls. Changing `variant` while open between `dialog` and another remounts the
children (their own state and focus reset), so keep state that must survive it above `Dialog.Content`.

members.description:
Maximum width: `sm` 400px for yes/no, `md` 560px (default) for a short form, `lg` 720px rarely.
Every size clamps to the viewport minus a 16px gutter, so a 390px phone gets a 358px dialog.

members.name: variant
members.description:
`dialog` (default) centres the popup. `sheet` is the same on wide viewports but below 640px it
becomes a bottom sheet: full width, rounded top, title and actions pinned while `Dialog.Body`
scrolls, padding that clears the home indicator. Use it for forms and pickers opened from a list.
`fullscreen` covers the viewport (inset by 16px with a rounded edge from 900px), slides in from the
inline end, keeps clear of the safe areas, and lets `Dialog.Body` scroll between a pinned title and
actions; `size` is ignored. It is the surface of `FullScreenFlow`. Pair it with `onRequestClose` on
the Root when leaving needs a confirmation.

Never open a dialog from inside one of the same variant: no sheet from a sheet, no full-screen dialog
from a full-screen one. Open a Popover or Menu instead, use a different variant (a small centred
`dialog` to confirm), or replace the content in place.

members.name: dismissOnSwipe
members.description:
`sheet` only. Below 640px a downward drag on the handle or the header (the top 64px, outside controls
and `Dialog.Body`) moves the sheet; letting go past 30% of its height, or flicking down, closes it the
way a press on the handle does (the handle is a `Dialog.Close` named "Dismiss"). Set `false` where an
accidental close loses work; the handle then stays as decoration only. Off whenever the Root is not
`dismissible`. Default `true`.

declarations.description:
Priority+ navigation: a row of primary links that keeps the ones that fit inline and collapses the rest
into a "More" disclosure at the end of the row. The current page is never collapsed. Follows the
WAI-ARIA APG disclosure navigation pattern (links in a list, a real button with `aria-expanded`), not
`role="menu"`. Server-renders every link inline, so it works before hydration and without JavaScript;
see docs/adr/0005-priority-nav.md.

members.description: Renders each link. Default a plain `<a>`; pass a router link: `(props) => <Link {...props} />`.

members.description:
Room in px the row must have beyond fitting every link before it stops reporting overflow. Set it to
the space your header gives back on overflow (the button label's width), so the two cannot oscillate.
Default 0.

events.description:
Called when links start or stop collapsing into "More" (also `data-overflowing` on the `nav`), so a
header can make room, e.g. an action button going icon-only.

slots.description:
Content at the end of the "More" panel, after the collapsed links and a divider: a control that belongs in the
overflow rather than a link, such as a theme switch. More exists while links are collapsed, and with `panelEnd`
also for as long as the row reports overflow (`onOverflowChange`), even once every link fits, so the content is
always reachable: pass it always, show an inline copy only while `onOverflowChange` says the row fits, and set
`overflowHysteresis` to the room that copy takes (its width and the gap before it). It is the panel list's last
item; Tab reaches it after the links, Escape returns to More, and clicks in it leave the panel open.

declarations.description:
Protokit's logo for a header: the Proton mark as the lowercase p of "protokit". The ring is the name's x-height and
sits on its baseline like an o; the stem runs down as the p's descender. The box is the word's ink, from the k's
top to the p's foot, so a header that centres it centres the word. 32px by default (the mark's size), or
`--proto-protokit-logo-size`; the electron is not drawn under 32px. Stem, ring and name take the inherited colour,
the nucleus and electron the accent.

declarations.name: ProtokitMark
declarations.description:
Protokit's mark, "Proton": a monogram P whose bowl is a ring around an accent nucleus, so it reads as a letter
first and an atom second. The stem and ring are `currentColor`, inherited from the context (so a link's hover or
pressed colour reaches them), the nucleus and electron `--proto-color-accent-default`; all `CanvasText` in forced
colours. Not the Job Sweep `Logo`, which is that product's mark.

members.description:
The mark's size: the Icon sizes (`xs` 12, `sm` 14, `md` 16, `lg` 20, `xl` 24), or `em` to follow the font size.
Default `lg`. For any other size (the brand's 32 and 96), set `--proto-protokit-mark-size` on the element. Under
24px the ring is drawn one unit heavier; under 32px the `orbit` electron is not drawn (it would smudge the nucleus).

members.description: The accessible name (`role="img"`). Default "Protokit".

members.name: orbit
members.description:
The electron, `inside` by default, or `false` for the plain P (a favicon, an avatar, print). It is parked at half past one (45° above 3 o'clock), that circles the nucleus clockwise once every 6s
(`--proto-protokit-mark-orbit-duration`) while the link or button around the mark is hovered or keyboard-focused.
Leaving stops it where it is, and the next hover carries on from there. `inside` circles in the bowl's counter,
between the nucleus and the ring; `outside` circles just outside the ring and passes behind the stem. Under
`prefers-reduced-motion` it stays parked. Not drawn under 32px. Decorative; it changes nothing that is read.

members.name: motion
members.description:
`hover` (default): the electron circles only while the link or button around the mark is hovered or focused.
`always`: it circles all the time, as in the header's `ProtokitLogo`. A loop that runs on its own for more than
